answer_1.quote: We propose a Multiagent Interactive Multi-hop Generation (MIMG) framework ... the Single-hop Question Generation Agent generates simple and direct single‑hop questions ... finally the Multi‑hop Question Merging Agent integrates these single‑hop questions into coherent multi‑hop queries.

answer_2.quote: Scoring method significantly outperforms binary classification, yielding higher kappa and precision scores (precision = 96.43%).

answer_3.quote: We prompt LLMs to assign continuous scores and determine a threshold using the validation set to filter high‑quality data. The scoring mechanism achieves a precision level of 96.43% relative to human evaluators.

answer_4.quote: Manual annotation is performed on a sample of 200 items. Participants are recruited from universities across China ... annotators evaluate quality from three aspects: logical rationality and fluency, question complexity, and answer clarity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate overall data quality based on logical rationality and fluency, question complexity, and answer clarity, each scored from 0 to 10.
